title: Rams star Puka Nacua still questionable to play Sunday vs. Broncos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams star Puka Nacua still questionable to play Sunday vs. Broncos
sources.description: The receiver, who has a groin soreness, did not participate in the team's light jog-through on Wednesday and coach Sean McVay is unsure when he will return.
